definitions.gloss: loose-lipped, indiscreet, unable to keep secrets
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who easily reveals secrets or private information to others.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{口|くち}が{軽|かる}いから、{秘密|ひみつ}を{話|はな}さないで。
examples.english: Don't tell him secrets because he's loose-lipped.

examples.japanese: {口|くち}が{軽|かる}い{人|ひと}には{大事|だいじ}な{話|はなし}はできない。
examples.english: You can't discuss important matters with someone who can't keep secrets.

examples.japanese: お{酒|さけ}を{飲|の}むと{口|くち}が{軽|かる}くなる。
examples.english: I become loose-lipped when I drink.

notes:
STRUCTURE: {口|くち} (mouth) + が + {軽|かる}い (light). Literally 'one's mouth is light' - implying words come out easily.

ANTONYM: {口|くち}が{堅|かた}い (tight-lipped, discreet)

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {口|くち}が{滑|すべ}る (to let something slip, say something by mistake)
- おしゃべり (talkative, chatterbox)
- {口|くち}が{悪|わる}い (to speak harshly, sharp-tongued) - different meaning

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japanese culture, keeping confidences is highly valued. Being called {口|くち}が{軽|かる}い is quite negative.
